name: tpu_top_apb_weight_load_seq
desc: Program the four weights W00..W11 via APB writes to mem[0..3] (i_psel & i_penable & i_pwrite).

name: tpu_top_data_in_stream_seq
desc: Drive input pairs on in1/in2 with in1_en/in2_en asserted to push words into the two input FIFOs.

name: tpu_top_start_seq
desc: Assert start to launch a compute pass; counter advances 1..5; deassert start at end of pass.

name: tpu_top_apb_result_read_seq
desc: APB reads (i_psel & i_penable & !i_pwrite) to pop result words from fifo_result via o_prdata.

name: tpu_top_fifo_boundary_seq
desc: Boundary stimulus on the input FIFOs: write past full / read at empty to exercise ignored writes/reads and modulo-8 pointer wrap.

name: tpu_top_rerun_seq
desc: Re-assert start with no new weights/inputs so done rises again on existing pipeline/FIFO contents (SC-003).

name: tpu_top_idle_seq
desc: No traffic: start held low, no APB or data activity (power idle / clock-tree / leakage baseline).

name: tpu_top_traffic_seq
desc: Sustained business-flow traffic: continuous weight loads + input streams + start passes at the typical rate.

name: tpu_top_peak_toggle_seq
desc: Worst-case full-toggle stimulus on all data inputs to maximize switching activity (PDN/IR-drop corner).
